headline: The all-volunteer Salinas Surf Club gives kids from East Salinas a chance to experience the ocean.
summary: Jeff Smallwood gets up early on Saturdays. On Sept. 19, he’s been up since about 6am checking surf reports and deciding which beach to head to.
